openings.claim: Variant switching may prolong selection/checking independently of layout complexity.
openings.discriminator: Grouped versus interleaved orders with identical layout/color composition; similar insertion times support switching.
openings.probe: Counterbalance both workers on reusable samples; time phases, log retries, wear and practice.
openings.uncertainty: Mixed batches confound switching with complexity; benefit must survive actual composition.

openings.claim: Order-specific diagrams may resolve short-partition ambiguity despite complete kits.
openings.discriminator: Fewer questions and placement errors with audited identical kits isolates instruction effects.
openings.probe: Randomly split ten participants between generic and ordered diagrams; record unaided completion, errors and preparation time.
openings.uncertainty: Exploratory; diagrams must match parts. Missing-part reports do not establish five verified omissions.

openings.claim: Shared partition codes connect completeness templates to placement guides, potentially enabling verified loose-kit packing.
openings.discriminator: Combined template/guide outperforms separate effects; saved insertion exceeds checking time.
openings.fit: Uncertain: costs, visible nonweakening codes and customer insertion feasibility.
openings.probe: Explore 2x2 template/guide conditions using 12 sets spanning all three counts; hold presentation/components fixed. Audit contents/color, time phases, assign ten first-use trials, record success/errors/help; separately compare assembled-workflow totals.
openings.uncertainty: Customer joint difficulty may defeat savings; overlapping widths do not establish retry causes.

lineage.reason: Distinct coded-interface interaction and assembly transfer.

decision: Allocate exploratory probes within 15 samples and ten participants. Preserve 30x20 footprint, assortment, removable joints, ordered counts/colors and fixed delivery. Combined initial spend <=500; added materials <=0.40/order. No stipulated evidence establishes the 60-unit targets: >=98% complete, median <=8 minutes, >=90% unaided.
